games.name: Agromatic
games.summary: Automated farming sim where specialized workers handle all tasks while you focus on strategic decisions. Design efficient layouts, manage supply chains across zones, and optimize your growing operation.

games.name: Come To My Party!
games.summary: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

games.name: Everfront
games.summary: A roguelike territory-control strategy game where you continuously expand against AI opponents. Master six doctrines, unlock upgrades, and dominate procedurally generated maps.

games.name: Green Inferno
games.summary: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

games.name: Infinity Ship
games.summary: Combine cards, pilot unique ships, and survive cosmic chaos. A frantic space roguelite where every fusion makes you an unstoppable force. Defeat colossal bosses and prove your worth as the Guardian of the Universe.

games.name: Jawed
games.summary: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

games.name: Jigenro
games.summary:
"JIGENRO" is a 3D color-matching puzzle game.

Click to grab and move panels on the field.

If you can connect all panels of the same color, you clear the stage.
Some stages feature fields with side walls or fields with elevation changes.

games.name: Kick
games.summary: Kick It is a Jump'n Run with a soccer ball. Navigate your ball with skill and finesse through a happy adventure.

games.name: Light of Atlantis
games.summary: In this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania you dive into the ruins of Atlantis. As a small robot you control the water level in various rooms to solve puzzles and discover the mysteries of an ancient society.

games.name: Love D3ath Love
games.summary: In 2222, your AI secretly sends over 3,000 job applications worldwide without you knowing. Soon after, three powerful women appear, each insisting you belong with her. You’re thrown into a growing crisis, their ambitions colliding endlessly. What do they actually want from you?

games.name: Luminleaf Chronicles
games.summary: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is the story of a group of cat girls who set out on an adventure to purify the world's water. In this game, you can choose different characters to go on your own adventures with others.

games.name: M.E.M.O
games.summary: Rely on nothing but your own wits. A first-person cryptographic adventure game that play with paper and pen. As you wander through the maze of memories, can you find the key to saving the future?

games.name: Magic Kingdom
games.summary: Self moving chess, RTS, Meat pigeon game. In the game, you will control the hero, lead a powerful army, release powerful magic, have a strong city defense, and coordinate resource collection to resist the enemy's strong attack

games.name: Moonlight Knight
games.summary: Moonlight Knight is an action-slasher with RPG elements. Use sword, bow, magic and hook to fight your enemies. Loot gold, upgrade character stats, find unique items and unlock ultimate abilities to make it to the very end!

games.name: Pozionista
games.summary: Travel through a world surrounded by nature, collect plants and use them to create potions, invent new recipes, sell potions in stores and explore the world.

games.name: Procession Engine
games.summary: A real-time tug-of-war roguelike deck builder. Your buildings spawn your army. Your cards, blueprints, and imbues decide what that army becomes. Place buildings in your yard, work the belt, and push two lanes until one stronghold falls.

games.name: Slotbound
games.summary: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

games.name: Steins;Gate: Octet of Shifting Space
games.summary: A non-canon extension of the True End of the original game. Unlike the modern visual novel format of the original game, this retro game perfectly mimics the style of graphical text adventure games from the 8-bit PC era (e.g. PC-88), with the player typing short commands to interact with and explore the game world. It features all backgrounds and characters drawn in a low-color pixelated style with emulated scanlines, chiptune music played through an emulated FM chip, and no voice acting. Although non-canon, the game contains many easter eggs and references that connect Chaos;Head and Steins;Gate together.

games.name: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
games.summary:
Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592 takes the 1592 war and bends it into alternate-history fantasy. You lead a ragtag company of exiles, defectors, and outlaws across battlefields where magic and steel share the same grid.

Terrain wins fights — along with skills, not just stat sheets
Every map is built on height. Take the high ground, force enemies onto bad footing, and play the four elements — earth, water, fire, wind — off each other. Read the turn order, land the right status effects, and you'll take fights you had no business winning.

games.name: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
games.summary: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

games.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
games.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

games.name: Wanderdawn
games.summary: Explore various worlds in a hack-and-slash action game - In a world ravaged by an unknown disaster, face various monsters with the diverse weapons you find.

games.name: Bolariki
games.summary: The match-3 roguelike. Stack relics, shatter rules, and pull off outrageous combos, all inside a puzzle game that boots like a fever dream from 1995. Crunchy, retro, and dangerously easy to start. Impossible to stop.

games.name: Bonki D Bonk
games.summary: Survive relentless enemy waves in a fast top-down survival game where your weapons attack for you. Move, dodge, and stack 30+ weapons with 100+ items into screen-filling chaos.

games.name: Snot Pop!
games.summary: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

games.name: Southern Lights: Broken Frequency
games.summary: Lead a stranded Antarctic research station where every decision matters. Manage your crew and its scarce resources while an unseen cosmic threat slowly tightens its grip.

games.name: SpaceShooter
games.summary: Blast through endless waves of deadly meteors in a fast-paced 2D arcade space shooter! Fight through 20 challenging stages, battle powerful bosses, customize your ship, discover unique meteor types, unlock weapons and upgrades, and survive the Endless Mode.

games.name: Sunset Artisan Chocolate
games.summary: Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique! Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

games.name: Survive the Apocalypse
games.summary: Turn-based roguelite in a post-apocalyptic world where you will have to make meaningful decisions (sounds familiar, capitalist world maybe). Make your way out of this ruined city, with eleven quarters (levels) and countless zones. Eat well, sleep well, decide well.

games.name: Tales of Tonbrook
games.summary: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid. When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it! Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

games.name: The Ice Is Watching
games.summary: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

games.name: Angel Guardian
games.summary: Angel Guardian is a side-scrolling action shooter where players take on the role of Kita, a warrior guardian, tasked with saving a prince from the forces of evil. Players can use action shooting, stealth, and hacking to defeat enemies and overcome obstacles

games.name: Ashes of Alice
games.summary: Do not stray off the path. Ashes of Alice is an atmospheric, PSX-style narrative survival game where the world has already ended. Follow a fading blood trail through a desolate, ash-choked landscape, piecing together the final moments of humanity before your vision goes dark for good.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

games.name: Iron Colony
games.summary: After crash-landing on a mysterious island, confront hostile robotic creatures in intense combat and strategic duels. Explore forgotten ruins, uncover secrets, and fight for survival in a world where corrupted technology dominates every corner.

games.name: Let’s Sing 2027
games.summary: Sing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.

games.name: Radiant Starlets
games.summary: Radiant Starlets is a HD2D action platformer in the vein of classic action platformers but you can date all the bosses. Select your boss order and make your way through 8 challenging stages. Try every order and uncover the mysteries of this world.

games.name: Sortilège
games.summary: A tactical dice duel between rival wizards. Read the table, press your luck, and outroll your opponent. Take on the singleplayer campaign or face off head-to-head online.

games.name: Wilderdark
games.summary: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

games.name: Blood of Rations
games.summary: Blood of Rations is a WW2 extraction shooter set in 1944 occupied Europe. Deploy alone into solo PvPvE raids, scavenge what the dead left behind, and extract alive — or lose everything you carried in. No minimap, all-diegetic audio, a grid inventory where every slot is a decision, and an 8-second extraction window. Between raids you rebuild the underground bunker you call home.

games.name: Bros of Bench
games.summary: Bros of Bench is a chaotic co-op platformer where two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Alternate between lifting each other and flying with jetpacks while mastering coordination, physics, and timing.

games.name: Build a Bot
games.summary: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

games.name: Crymelight
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Emery Hearts
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this thrilling action JRPG and uncover the secrets of Emery crystals as you face challenging enemies that will demand all your skill and ingenuity to defeat them.

games.name: Feed Me More Brains
games.summary: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

games.name: Glory On Pluto
games.summary: Bring prestige back to Earth by building your engines and finding Glory on Pluto in this offbeat and unique deckbuilding rougelike.

games.name: K-Pop Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game! Dance and sing your way through the competition and rise to glory. Customise your character to your image, it is your time to shine!

games.name: Wielders of the Essence
games.summary: Incremental base-building horde survival. Short runs earn you resources to construct buildings, which unlock new powers, troops, and spells. Every run pushes you forward, even if you die. Delightfully chaotic and surprisingly chill.

games.name: Brothel Virgin: The Crimson Reverie
games.summary: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary: Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games; Monopoly, The Game of Life, and Clue to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

games.name: Lost Media Agency
games.summary: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.

games.name: Borbs
games.summary: Reunite chonky borbs with their flock in this relaxing puzzle game, brought to life by hand-drawn artwork from a longtime bird keeper.

games.name: Hantu and Hunted
games.summary: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

games.name: Ho Ho Ho Sokoban
games.summary: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

games.name: Never Sort By Color
games.summary:
Never Sort By Color is a first-person zen organization game where you use magnet gloves, part detection, sieves, and quick hotkey tossing to sort an enormous pile of plastic bricks into a labeled workshop. Instead of sorting by color, you sort by part type, rebuilding drawers and organizing bays as the floor area opens up.
As you complete categories, instruction books guide you to pull exact parts from the right drawers to assemble MOCs that snap together brick by brick, turning the quiet sorting loop into satisfying, functional model building.

games.name: Patience Balls
games.summary: Patience Balls is a minimalist physics-based puzzle game focused on tilt mechanics and precision. Players navigate one or more balls through intricate labyrinths and mazes to reach designated goal spots. The gameplay emphasizes steady control and logic across multiple themed worlds. It includes global leaderboards and unlockable achievements within a performance-optimized, clean visual style designed for short, meditative sessions.

games.name: Hill-Z
games.summary: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?

games.name: Mythfall
games.summary: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg. Face deadly bosses, forge alliances, and carve your legacy in a world where every fight could be your last.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
games.summary:
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world.

In the single-player interactive novel villain team-up game "There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.," you play as his greatest adversaries. Can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. (short for a "Very Important Collective of Terrorists, Operatives, and Rogues") defeat the only man standing between them and world domination?

To the V.I.C.T.O.R. go the spoils!

games.name: Echo 9
games.summary: Echo 9 is a tense first-person horror. You are Yon, a maintenance android. Navigate a failing shuttle through deep space, stabilize the dying reactor, and bring Eva to the evacuation point. Radiation is rising, the evacuation point far. Eva is in stasis. You are all she has.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
games.summary:
From the creative minds of the Persona series – Metaphor: ReFantazio marks ATLUS’ first ever, full-scale fantasy RPG, brought to you by director Katsura Hashino, character designer Shigenori Soejima, and composer Shoji Meguro.

Write your destiny and rise above fear as you step into a fantasy world unlike anything you’ve seen before. Fraught with unsettling mystery, the kingdom stands on a precipice. Now, you must embark on a journey, overcoming obstacles and forging bonds with friends.

games.name: The Totemist
games.summary: Run an occult shop in a quietly strange town, crafting totems and talismans inspired by real witchcraft. Help townspeople with their burdens at your own pace while uncovering an ancient darkness beneath the town, one only you can stop.

games.name: Fancy Farm Brawl
games.summary: Closed Playtest Now Live! Mix relaxing farming & tower defense. Early testers average over 98 minutes per play session. Click Request Access on store page to apply for limited slots.

games.name: World 23
games.summary: Battle through decaying mega-cities, abandoned metro tunnels, and guarded enemy facilities in this fast-paced top-down hack and slash. As Theo and Leo, you master abilities and switch weapons during combat to match your play style and the challenge ahead.

games.name: Zero Sum
games.summary: A hand-drawn twin-stick roguelite where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Subtract, divide, root, modulo. 7 operators, 22 firing modes, 9 bosses, 80+ upgrades. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars, just raw arithmetic violence. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

games.name: Space Station Designer
games.summary: Space Station Designer is a construction and management game that puts you in charge of creating and expanding a network of orbital outposts in Earth and Lunar orbits.

games.name: Axyn Adventure
games.summary: Axyn Adventure is a retro style 3D platformer. You take control of the titular character Axyn and embark on many adventures with your friends Yunn and Leaf. Play in the vast open levels using your big set of moves to get around. Collect as many items as you can to advance the story and unlock tons of content.

games.name: Dungeon of Departure
games.summary: an independently developed, pixel art, visual novel set in an original universe which follows the silent, player protagonist and three companion characters as they struggle to find a way out of an increasingly puzzling, underground world.

games.name: Flick
games.summary: Shift realities with the flick of a light switch and plunge into the grotesque to uncover your family's twisted past. A psychological horror game where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

games.name: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
games.summary: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the Grand Theft Auto series yet.

games.name: Iona's Island
games.summary: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders and help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape a world with accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

games.name: Lord of Undead
games.summary: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

games.name: Microscape
games.summary: Heavily inspired by Runescape, Microscape is a tiny community idle game for Twitch streams. Channel owners can add their community to the world. Players then earn playtime by being in these communities.

games.name: Phantom Vice Auto
games.summary: Experience entertainment blockbusters Phantom Vice Auto and Phantom Vice Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for Phantom Vice Auto Online players.

games.name: Psycasso
games.summary:
Take on the role of a serial killer who creates paintings with their victims blood! Sell your creations to earn money while trying to avoid capture by the police and other civilians.

In this pixel art adventure you'll play as Psycasso, a struggling gallery artist living in an open world city. By day you'll work a day job to earn money and level up skills, seamlessly blending into society. By night you'll be on the lookout to harvest 'red paint' from one of the 'walking meat-bags' to help you create original 2D art. Sell your artwork to art galleries for huge profits! Become rich from your unique artwork while avoiding capture from the ever growing police presence using stealth techniques and unique traps. Buy property, upgrades, furniture, weapons, discover a bustling city and play a host of mini games in this controversial indie title like nothing before.

games.name: The Legend of the 4 Elements
games.summary: The Legend of the 4 Elements is a platformer with elemental combat. Control heroes of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, use unique abilities, overcome challenges, battle dangerous enemies, and restore balance to the world of the elements.

games.name: Circuit Keep
games.summary: Circuit Keep is a grid‑based tower defense game where players build and upgrade circuit‑themed defenses to repel escalating waves of intrusions. The game features a campaign of handcrafted lattices, a research system, and multiple enemy types with unique behaviors. Players manage resources, optimize layouts, and adapt to changing threats across increasingly complex maps.

games.name: Ages of Cataria
games.summary: Care for generations of townsfolk in a land of mystique and wonder. Build colonies along side your friends in this multiplayer colony sim and narrative RPG.

games.name: Project Atlas
games.summary: In a universe where everything is falling into chaos, one person and their new found companion are out to save the universe from total destruction. Experience heart pounding battle action, animal handling skills, survival skills, and even some fishing along the way. Includes solo story mode, multiplayer 6v6 team death match, and a battle royale. Set in the near future where humans battle resource deprivation, and climate change on worlds. Yet off world threats are the real danger! Battle through countless missions with your customizable K-9 companion. Can the universe be saved or was it doomed from the start?

games.name: Turbo Turkey
games.summary: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

games.name: Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou
games.summary: Sprite's 15th anniversary game. A share house receives an odd purchase offer one day and, around the same time, a new girl with suspicious behavior moves in.

games.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Ship Miner
games.summary: Relaxing mining experience that merges combat elements and 1-bit pixel art aesthetics. Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy. Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

games.name: Death and Tactics
games.summary: A post apocalyptic turn-based strategy game. Permanent death is a primary mechanic, with unique events being unlocked based on how you play the game. And there are many ways to play! Such as: selling the organs of party members you don't like, turning your enemies into monsters, and much, much more!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.
